title: Bulk selection switches do not target the groups rendered by the UI
reasoning: The UI groups runs by model_name, but the callback matches switch indices against the filesystem parent directory name. These need not match, so model switches select or deselect no runs, or the wrong runs. Additionally, 'subgroup-select-switch' contains 'group-select-switch', so subgroup events enter the earlier parent branch and never reach subgroup handling.
reproduction: Render a run with model_name='Model A' and value='/runs/batch/run1'. Toggle its model switch, then its prompt subgroup switch. Neither targets the rendered run correctly.
recommendation: Parse the JSON component ID once, dispatch on exact type equality, and match groups using the same model_name and prompt_template keys as the UI builder.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover data processing and scoring, with no hierarchical selection callback scenarios.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover model and prompt bulk selection and deselection across multiple models and prompts, using directory names different from model names and asserting unrelated selections remain unchanged.
minimumFixScope: Bulk-switch dispatch and group matching in _manage_run_selection_logic.

history.reasoning: Both evidence files and cited ranges still exist. settings_content.py:76–123 still groups by model_name and prompt_template.
